What to expect from the Bachelor's programme Computing Science

headings.text: Our Bachelor's degree programme in computing science is connected to the Bernoulli Institute.
headings.parent:
Our Bachelor's degree programme in computing science is connected to the Bernoulli Institute.

The mission of the Bernoulli Institute is to perform outstanding academic research and teaching in Mathematics, Computer Science, and Artificial Intelligence, and to maintain international leadership herein; to foster these disciplines as a living body of knowledge, and to make it relevant to society in its broadest sense. The symbiosis between pure and applied science, and between mono- and multidisciplinary research and teaching, is a distinguishing characteristic of our institute. Data Science Major - Bachelor of Computer and Information Sciences
